source.notes: Genuine ICSE 2024 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (official ZIP bundle). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours (plus 15 minutes reading time). Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has fifteen 1-mark MCQs (marks from the [15] bracket), Questions 2 and 3 carry marks printed per sub-part. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' and offers six 10-mark questions (4-9); all six are extracted, so the pack's marks total (100) intentionally exceeds maxMarks (80). Sub-parts are split at the level where marks are printed ((i), (ii), (iii)); their own (a)/(b)/(c) items stay together in the text unless noted. No internal 'OR' choices are printed, so choiceGroup is null throughout. Figures, diagrams and circuit diagrams are not reproduced. Paper code 'T24 521' printed in the footer; 'This Paper consists of 12 printed pages'; PDF page numbers equal the printed page numbers. Question 2(i) combines a radioisotope item (a) with a lever-class item (b) under one [3], and 2(ii) has two fill-in blanks under one [2]; these were split (splits not printed; flagged). Q1(ix) has diagram-only options, so it carries no options. Degree signs, powers, subscripts, fractions and nuclear-equation numbers printed as raised/lowered characters were rebuilt as Unicode and flagged.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
